name: Formal Linguistics and Natural Language Processing
description: This course introduces students to the core concepts of formal linguistics—syntax, semantics, and morphology—and demonstrates how these concepts inform natural language processing (NLP). Students will learn how formal models of linguistic structure (phrase structure, grammar, meaning representation) connect to computational applications such as parsing, machine translation, sentiment analysis, and information extraction. The course bridges the gap between human language structure and computational models, enabling students to design linguistically informed NLP systems.
